title: feat: add map quick actions

issue.title: TASK-d91f feat: add map quick actions

description: Make frequent map and route actions immediately accessible without searching the main panel.
requirements: Add My location, Fit route to map, Clear route, and Undo last action.
Add accessible labels and tooltips where appropriate.
Fit the map to the complete route after route creation or changes when appropriate.
Show lightweight success/error feedback for user actions.
Keep controls clear of important map content and adapt them for mobile.
definitionOfReady: See GitHub Issue #10 for the definitionOfReady definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Available actions can be executed directly from the quick-actions control.
Fit-to-route frames the complete current route correctly.
Unavailable actions are visibly disabled and cannot be triggered.
Action feedback is understandable and non-blocking.
Controls work on desktop and mobile without obscuring key map interactions.
Existing route creation and editing flows continue to work.
technicalApproach: Implement the floating control inside MapClient so actions share the existing map, route, points, and reset state. Keep a bounded point-history stack for undo, use browser geolocation for My location, reuse route geometry bounds for Fit route, and expose non-blocking status feedback.
definitionOfDone: Relevant tests are added or updated.
No regression in map interaction behavior.

history.details: Registered from GitHub Issue #10 before implementation.
